name: SIP Troubleshooting
description: Separate a SIP failure into signaling, routing, authentication, NAT, media, codec, carrier response, or endpoint behavior.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Read logs for a process this run already started.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
Run a command on a configured server alias.
Read the official page a search result named.

validation.rule: The SIP response or log line was cited, and the fault class was one the evidence supports.
